assistants.title: Connect Claude, ChatGPT or Grok
assistants.intro: No API key to copy: add SupoClip as a custom connector in the assistant, then sign in to SupoClip and allow access. The assistant gets its own key, listed under API keys.
assistants.revoke: Each connection appears under API keys, named after the app (for example “Claude connector”). Revoke it to disconnect. Making clips through an assistant uses your plan's video minutes.

steps.1: In Claude, open Customize › Connectors, select Add, then Add custom connector.
steps.2: Name it SupoClip, paste the server URL and click Continue.
steps.3: Keep the sign-in settings Claude marks Detected. If it asks how Claude identifies itself, choose Register automatically. Click Add.
steps.4: Click Connect, sign in to SupoClip and select Allow.

claude.availability: Anthropic supports custom connectors on Free (one connector), Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise. On Team and Enterprise, an Owner adds it under Organization settings › Connectors, then each member clicks Connect.
claude.code: Claude Code: run these in a terminal and sign in when the browser opens.

steps.1: On ChatGPT on the web, open Plugins, select +, then Add custom MCP server.
steps.2: Name it SupoClip and paste the server URL under Connection.
steps.3: Set authentication to OAuth, accept the risk warning and select Create as a plugin.
steps.4: Install the plugin, sign in to SupoClip and select Allow. ChatGPT asks you to confirm each action that makes or changes clips.

chatgpt.availability: OpenAI offers custom MCP servers on ChatGPT web for Business, Enterprise and Edu; on Business, admins and owners add them. Pro accounts only get read-only tools, so ChatGPT can list your clips but not make new ones. OpenAI doesn't document it for other plans.

steps.1: On grok.com, open Connectors, select New Connector, then Custom.
steps.3: Complete the sign-in: sign in to SupoClip and select Allow.

grok.availability: xAI says connectors are available to all Grok users; on Business and Enterprise an admin adds the connector in the xAI console first. xAI doesn't document which sign-in methods custom connectors support, so this flow is not confirmed for Grok. If it fails, connect another assistant or use an API key below.
